name: Ricardo Vargas
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during his engineering studies in Lima. A guest lecture by a visiting Formula 1 aerodynamicist sparked an immediate passion. After graduating, he honed his skills at a local automotive research facility, gaining invaluable experience in computational fluid dynamics and wind tunnel testing. He then sought an opportunity in Europe, eventually landing a role at Blau Motorsport. 

Ricardo approaches his work with a meticulous eye for detail, meticulously analyzing airflow patterns and pressure distributions to optimize aerodynamic performance. His methodical nature allows him to identify even the smallest improvements, and his experience is invaluable to the team. He is always looking for new ways to interpret data and improve the car's performance.

Ricardo is known for his adaptability and willingness to collaborate with engineers from other departments. He is quick to learn new techniques and adapt to changing priorities, making him a valuable asset in the fast-paced world of motorsport.

physical.description: Ricardo is of medium build with a focused gaze and a friendly smile.
